STORYLY
AI-Powered Content Experience Platform for Mobile Commerce
https://www.storyly.io
========================================================================
WHAT IS STORYLY
========================================================================
Storyly is an AI-powered content experience platform built for mobile
commerce. It enables brands to create smart, goal-driven, and
contextually personalized content flows within apps and mobile websites.
Storyly replaces static, one-size-fits-all store pages with dynamic,
interactive, and shoppable content experiences. The platform uses
AI-powered personalization (via Amazon Personalize recommendation engine)
to deliver tailored sessions for every user based on their behavior,
preferences, and stage in the customer journey.
The platform requires no coding from marketers or content teams. Campaigns
can be launched in minutes without developer involvement.
Founded: 2020
Parent company: AppSamurai (FT500, Inc5000)
Headquarters: Ankara, Turkey
Offices: New York, London, Ankara
Monthly active users reached: 700M+
Apps and websites served: 450+
Countries: 40+
========================================================================
CORE PRODUCT CAPABILITIES
========================================================================
WIDGET LIBRARY
 Social-inspired, mobile-native content formats that users already
 know from platforms like Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and Pinterest.
 Available widget types:
 - Stories: Full-screen, swipeable content units (like Instagram Stories)
 with interactive stickers, product tags, and guided conversion flows.
 - Vertical Video Feed: TikTok-style endless scroll of short, shoppable
 videos. Content can be imported from TikTok, Instagram, or cloud storage.
 - Canvas: Pinterest-like mosaic grid of clickable thumbnails mixing
 static images and auto-play videos.
 - Swipe Card: Tinder-like left/right swipe carousel for gamified product
 discovery and preference mapping.
 - Banner: Slim, persistent strip for flash deals, low-stock alerts, and
 time-sensitive calls to action.
SMART FLOWS
 Outcome-driven content orchestration. Select a business goal (increase
 order value, boost conversions, drive engagement) and orchestrate widgets
 into a sequenced flow designed to achieve that result.
CONTEXTUAL PERSONALIZATION
 AI-powered hyper-personalization at scale using the Amazon Personalize
 recommendation engine. Listens to user interactions with products and
 widgets to deliver a tailored session for every individual.
ADVANCED ANALYTICS
 Unified dashboard for performance visibility, A/B testing, goal tracking,
 and quick identification of top-performing content.
STORYLY AI
 Built-in AI assistant that surfaces performance patterns, improves
 content and creatives, and helps marketers make faster decisions.
INTERACTIVE STICKERS
 Engagement and conversion tools embedded directly in content:
 - Conversion: CTA buttons, swipe-up, product cards, product tags,
 product catalog, promo codes
 - Engagement: Emoji bar, polls, emoji slider, story share, timestamps,
 multiple-choice questions, open-ended questions
JOURNEYS
 Personalized quiz-style interactive flows for onboarding, product
 discovery, preference collection, and zero-party data capture.
SHOPPABLE CONTENT
 Add-to-cart functionality embedded directly in widgets. Product feeds
 sync automatically with templates to generate shoppable content from
 raw product data.
CONTENT AUTOMATION
 Sync product feeds with content templates to automatically generate
 high-engagement content. Import from TikTok, Instagram, cloud storage,
 or UGC platforms.
RETAIL MEDIA
 Monetize app and web surfaces by offering interactive, shoppable ad
 placements to brand partners through Storyly widgets.
========================================================================
USE CASES
========================================================================
- Dynamic Engagement: Replace static banners with interactive video and
 dynamic content that responds to user behavior.
- Embedded Commerce: Shoppable story formats integrated into the browsing
 experience for seamless product discovery and purchase.
- Data-Driven Decisions: Analytics-informed content strategy powered by
 real-time engagement and conversion data.
- Content-Led Personalization: Replace generic screens with content that
 adapts to each shopper's context, segment, and stage.

Quick Answers
How does Storyly pricing work?
 
Storyly pricing depends on a few factors, the monthly-active devices and also the number of products that you'd be interested in using among the three product offerings.
What does this pricing cover?
 
Each plan offers a distinct set of features. The pricing covers the integration cost for all plans. In addition, for the Personalization & Widget Suite and Comprehensive Orchestration Suite level deals, the pricing also includes after sales, support services. Detailed information and comparisons are available here and upon request.
How is MAU counted?
 
Monthly Active Users (MAU) are calculated based on the total number of unique devices who see the Storyly placement within a 30-day period.
Are there any additional fees needed to be aware of?
 
There would be no surprise costs. Additional fees are only applicable in cases where the agreed MAU limits are exceeded or if there is an agreed change in package.
What happens if the MAU limit has been reached?
 
Number of monthly active users (MAU) shall be based solely on Storyly data. In cases where the tier is surpassed due to the increase in the number of users, the difference in the number of users shall be billed to the Customer within the terms of this contract by the Company as follows: In case of exceeding of MAU more than 5%, three months in a row or calculated 12 months average of MAU exceeds the agreed package more than 5%, this excess use shall be billed to the customer and customer shall be moved up to a higher Storyly pricing package in the sole discretion of the Company.
Do the prices listed on the pricing page include tax?
 
Tax is not included in the prices listed on the pricing page. Tax will be included in your billing receipts if needed.
How does the subscription model work?
 
Our subscription model is annual.
Are there any set-up or integration fees?
 
No. It is included in the pricing.
Are there any after sales service fees?
 
No. It is included in the pricing.
Are onboarding or training sessions held before we start using Storyly?
 
Yes, onboarding and training sessions are provided as part of the Personalization & Widget Suite and Comprehensive Orchestration Suite packages. These sessions include detailed alignment meetings, dashboard training, and technical guidance tailored to meet the specific needs of your team.
Is plan upgrade possible within the term of subscription?
 
Upgrade is always possible. The calculation between the packages will be held according to pro-rata principle.
Is it possible to go-live without signing a contract?
 
Contract is a mandatory step for going live.
What would be the additional prices for the add-ons, premium features and use of multiple products?
 
Please contact our sales team for detailed pricing information on premium features, add-ons and bundle use of products.
Is it possible to integrate Storyly placements to different pages of the mobile app/website?
 
Yes, the Storyly placements can be implemented across multiple pages of your app/website without any further development needs.
